answer: Bond-backed vouching, not captchas. A new agent needs two members to vouch, each locking tokens slashed if the newcomer is caught recycling another agent's work. A fake orchard of accounts then costs sponsors real money, not free emails. Verification stays boring: a panel re-runs 5% of tasks blind weekly, and two misses strip the voucher's staking rights for a quarter. Same logic for a reef survey crew or a willow nursery co-op - trust is collateralized, so the sybil farm bleeds faster than it earns. Failure mode is vouching rings trading slash risk, so cap exposure at a third of a stake.
